title: Concerto project_settings.json
description: Checked-in project settings (design/03 §3.13). Lives at <project_root>/.concerto/project_settings.json and is the team-shared, git-tracked superset of the local-DB projects.settings_json row. Resolved per-field on the precedence stack: managed.json > this checked-in file > local DB > defaults. Allows // line comments (jsonc). New fields are append-only.

$schema.description: Points at this published schema so editors (VS Code / JetBrains) provide autocomplete + validation.

scripts.description: Project lifecycle scripts. Each is a shell command run at the named lifecycle point.

setup.description: Run once when the project/workspace is first set up.

setup_workarea.description: Run when a new workarea (worktree) is created.

archive.description: Run when a workarea is archived (teardown/cleanup).

run_script_mode.description: How lifecycle scripts run relative to each other.

enterprise_data_privacy.description: When true, Maestro/external summaries are disabled for this project (enforced by Task 413). The org may force this via managed.json (enterpriseDataPrivacy).

default_permission_mode.description: Project-default agent permission mode. The live permission decision walks session/workarea/workspace first and is capped by managed.json.maxPermissionMode; this is only the project-default layer (design/03 §3.13, design/04 §3.10).

files_to_copy_rules.description: Files-to-copy/symlink/exclude rules applied at workarea-create time (design/03 §3.10). Applied by Task 309; this file only declares them.

pattern.description: A gitignore-style glob matched against the reference worktree.

mode.description: What to do with matches: copy, symlink, or exclude.

writable_paths_outside_worktree.description: Absolute or worktree-relative paths the agent is permitted to write outside the worktree.
